description: Displayed inside the Brest Fortress complex; OpenStreetMap names it «Samolot PWS-26 81-71». NO ORIGINAL PWS-26 IS KNOWN TO SURVIVE ANYWHERE so this is a replica or reproduction and 81-71 must be treated as a painted marking rather than an identity; operator recorded as PL because the type served only the Polish Air Force and Brest was Polish Brześć until 1939
